description: Official tool manifest for ANA_MAX local LAB agent.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads a UTF-8 text file from the local workspace.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Writes UTF-8 text to a file in the local workspace.

tools.name: open_browser
tools.description: Opens a URL in the local browser controller.

tools.name: system_info
tools.description: Returns basic information about the local LAB environment.

tools.name: current_time
tools.description: Returns the current local date, time, weekday, and timezone.

tools.name: open_windows_app
tools.description: Opens a safe allowlisted local Windows app such as calculator, notepad, Brave, Chrome, Edge, paint, or explorer.

tools.name: open_url_in_windows_app
tools.description: Opens an http/https URL in a safe allowlisted local browser such as Brave, Chrome, or Edge.

tools.name: find_app
tools.description: Finds a safe allowlisted local Windows app command or executable path without launching it.

tools.name: process_list
tools.description: Lists local Windows processes through tasklist with optional name filtering.

tools.name: installed_apps
tools.description: Lists installed Windows applications from registry uninstall metadata.

tools.name: system_overview
tools.description: Returns local OS, CPU, Python, workspace, and disk metadata.

tools.name: frida_status
tools.description: Reports whether the local Frida Python module is available; status only, no attach or instrumentation.

tools.name: desktop_screenshot
tools.description: Captures a local Desktop screenshot to ANA_MAX logs/screenshots.

tools.name: desktop_list_items
tools.description: Lists visible Desktop files and folders as metadata without reading file contents.

tools.name: desktop_inspect_folder
tools.description: Lists one Desktop folder's visible child files and folders as metadata without reading file contents.

tools.name: desktop_read_text_file
tools.description: Reads a bounded allowed text file from the Desktop or one Desktop folder.

tools.name: desktop_write_text_file
tools.description: Writes ASCII-safe text or Markdown to the Desktop with backup on overwrite.

tools.name: calculate_expression
tools.description: Evaluates a safe arithmetic expression such as 5*5.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetches a URL and returns simplified text content.

tools.name: web_scrape
tools.description: Fetches an http/https URL, extracts clean text, and returns bounded JSON metadata.

tools.name: web_learn_url
tools.description: Scrapes one http/https URL, summarizes it, and stores bounded text chunks into RAG.

tools.name: web_learn_course
tools.description: Learns a bounded same-domain course or documentation path into RAG across multiple pages.

tools.name: browser_search_read
tools.description: Builds a web search URL, opens it in an allowlisted local browser, and reads the same page through web_scrape.

tools.name: vector_search
tools.description: Searches semantic memory for similar chunks.

tools.name: vector_store
tools.description: Stores text into semantic memory.

tools.name: rag_store_text
tools.description: Stores text chunks into RAGBridge with source metadata.

tools.name: desktop_create_python_script
tools.description: Creates a folder on the user's Desktop and writes a Python script inside it, with backup on overwrite.
